notes: Decoded JSON API bytes, not wire-compressed transfer. Assets and open SSE excluded. Home capture ends800ms after first visible tile and includes96 loaded miniature rows (48 initial page+prefetch48).

Browser timing uses navigation-relative performance.now() to first real miniature tile+two animation frames, injected MutationObserver independent of CDP body parsing. Three sequential fresh server/browser samples per profile, seeded disk not cold disk. No extra QA probe rows.

Canonical Phase0 times are synchronous SQLite read+serialization, NOT browser latency. Fresh pre-migration main@ea86dd1 browser reconstruction is separately labelled, built privately from historical locked source. Small response-size differences vs canonical are revision cursor metadata, not different seed rows.
RSS is process resident memory sampled after800ms, not JS heap/peak/cold memory or attribution to GraphQL. No canonical Phase0 RSS exists.

Bundle sums all emitted JS/per-file gzip; entry independent. Not all chunks transfer at startup. Canonical Phase1 bundle (999731B/334658gzip) differs from reconstructed Phase0 baseline (998224B/334242gzip).

Per-screen bytes are navigation windows from a fresh client after Home on one warm server and exclude Home. Plugins can include variable external availability metadata; checks deferred until Plugins opens.
